bio: Located on the first basement level, the dining space features an industrial interior crafted from stone and earth, where dramatic lighting accentuates the counter. The menu boasts an extensive selection of appetisers and pasta dishes. Sharing is a great way to sample a variety of flavours, or you can opt for full portions to ensure each plate leaves a lasting impression. The predominantly à la carte offerings evolve according to what is sourced each day, and the kitchen stays open late. Versatile and welcoming, and in the prime locale of Nishi-Azabu.
